name: Hidden
text: While you’re out of sight from all enemies and they don’t otherwise know your location, you gain the _{{term:hidden|Hidden}}_ condition. Any rolls against a _{{term:hidden|Hidden}}_ creature have {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}}. After an adversary moves to where they would see you, you move into their line of sight, or you make an attack, you are no longer _{{term:hidden|Hidden}}_.

name: Restrained
text: _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ characters can’t move, but you can still take actions from their current position.

name: Vulnerable
text: When a creature is _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}},_ all rolls targeting them have {{term:advantage|advantage}}.
